text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Man, I couldn't sleep at all...! I was way 
too nervous! Whoa...! Do your best, 
C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm begging you, show us the start 
of a new legend! Prove that you're the 
strongest Umamusume out there!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ace. Do you remember what I told you at 
the summer training camp?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I remember, word for word.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"‘I am Mr. C.B. You are Katsuragi Ace. 
Neither more, nor less than that’... 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ever since entering the Classic campaign, 
everyone around me has been expecting all 
sorts of things from me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“None of that mattered to me, though. I 
ran simply because I wanted to enjoy 
racing with you, my rival.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I thought it was fun. I was 
completely engrossed in it. ...But you 
weren't.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You only saw me as a wall to overcome, not 
as Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...! That can't beâ

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I wouldn't be so fixated solely 
on "surpassing" you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You don't see me for who I truly am. 
...And right now, that frustrates me more 
than anything.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, your eyes are set on how to 
overcome this, not on victory."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...That's not a race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've made up my mind. Today, 
I'll use my true strength to crush you 
completely."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Because then, I'll surely get to see your 
true, bellicose and rebellious face."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The faintly overheard conversation between 
Mr. C.B. and Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying an unusually heated tension in 
the air, the curtain rose on the Kikuka 
Sho.
